concept: A green spine carries the whole message over the photo: kicker above a white rule, BBQ / PARTY as the focal pair, the address running vertically down the spine, a second rule, 3PM / SATURDAY at the foot. The spine hugs the left edge and scales with the canvas height (full width on the skyscraper); on 4:1 banners it turns into a horizontal band whose rules become dividers and the address reads horizontally.
